# Tabs

Switches between views of the same thing on one page.

**In Dense data.** Views of one record. Family: navigation. Reference: Open UX (tabs), MIT.

## See it live

<iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-tabs--examples&viewMode=story" title="Tabs examples in Storybook" loading="lazy" style="width:100%;height:320px;border:1px solid var(--color-border-default);border-radius:var(--radius-container)"></iframe>

[Open Tabs in Storybook](http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-tabs--docs): every variant, the playground and its controls, in every theme.

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Related views of one object that people move between.
- **Not when:** Navigation to other pages (links), or steps of a task (progress).

Instead:

- Accordion: Stacked sections people can open together.
- Navigation menu: Other pages.

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys move between tabs; Tab moves into the panel. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a tablist; the selected tab owns its panel. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add tabs
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tabs/indicator` | Active tab indicator. | `color.action.primary.@` → `dense-data.theme.light.color.action.primary.@` → `color.violet.light.600` | `color.action.primary.@` → `dense-data.theme.dark.color.action.primary.@` → `color.violet.dark.700` |
| `tabs/label/@` | Inactive tab label. | `color.text.secondary` → `dense-data.theme.light.color.text.secondary` → `color.slate.light.700` | `color.text.secondary` → `dense-data.theme.dark.color.text.secondary` → `color.slate.dark.500` |
| `tabs/label/active` | Active tab label. | `color.text.primary` → `dense-data.theme.light.color.text.primary` → `color.slate.light.900` | `color.text.primary` → `dense-data.theme.dark.color.text.primary` → `color.slate.dark.900` |
